tips.text: Pick New Game to start! Use the arrow keys and press Enter, or click.
Pick the place you want to explore first. You can open the others later with map parts.
Welcome to Ansonville! Walk with the arrow keys or WASD. Walk into your open gate to explore.
Hi! Go through your open gate. Walk in tall grass, sand, snow or ash to find wild monsters.
Wild monsters hide in the tall grass, sand, snow and ash. The shop and Reviver are by the exit.
No monster yet? Throw a cage! If it breaks free, try again. After 3 misses it runs away.
Pick Fight to attack. Lower HP means a better chance to catch it. Press F for 2x speed.
Walk into the Reviver to heal your team for free. If you lose a battle, you wake up there.
Press M for the menu: your Team, Backpack, Bag and Monster Book. Press M or Esc to close it.
Pick a monster with Enter, then pick another to swap. The first one on your team fights first.
Pick a Potion or Wake-Up Snack, then pick who gets it. In battle, Bag works the same way.
Your Monster Book shows every monster you have seen and caught. Catch all the wild ones to open Avatar's arena!
Each monster grows into a new form at its own level. Win battles to level up!
Pick something, use left and right for how many, then Enter to buy. A map part opens a new gate!
Locked gates need a map part. Buy one at the shop for 50 Magic Gems. Win battles to earn gems.
